SessionStart.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/sc-sessionstart"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SessionStart; fi

PreInvocation.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/sc-sessionstart"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event PreInvocation; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PreInvocation; fi

hooks.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/sc-pretooluse"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PreToolUse; fi
R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/sc-posttooluse"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PostToolUse; fi

PostInvocation.command: R="${PWD}"; B="$R/bin/sc-stop"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="$R/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook Stop; fi
